address: Canby Residents, Reminder to sign up for alerts to your home or business address from the 911 system in the event of a future emergency. Canby residents can sign up to receive alerts from Canby Police, Canby Fire, and Clackamas County Sheriff through Clackamas County by visiting: https://www.clackamas.us/dm/publicalerts Remind your friends and neighbors to check their phone settings and registration settings at the above Clackamas County website. This may be the only information you receive during future large emergency events. Visit www.canbyfire.org for details.
SE 82ND AVE & SE LINDY ST, HAPPY VALLEY, OR
